summary: Sony Group Corp files Form 6-K to disclose an agreement with Honda Motor Co. to scale down operations at their joint venture Sony Honda Mobility (SHM). The venture is discontinuing development and launch of its AFEELA electric vehicle models due to Honda's revised electrification strategy. Operations will be downsized, and employees reassigned to parent companies. This represents a restructuring of the joint venture, not a formal divestiture or acquisition. The filing does not provide financial terms or valuations. No breakup fees, closing timelines, or deal advisors are named. Watch for further collaboration discussions under a new framework.
